overview: AI models are expanding into legacy codebases, improving maintenance of critical infrastructure.
Security incidents highlight vulnerabilities in AI development tools and API key management.
Major compute investments and emerging AI agents reshape industry economics and web interactions.

top.title: Advancing coding in low‑resource programming languages
top.summary: OpenAI released GPT‑6 models that markedly improve coding in low‑resource languages like COBOL and Fortran, achieving up to 87% pass rates on MultiLangBench and 98% accuracy on COBOL migration, while reducing API costs.

top.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
top.summary: OpenCode’s Console suffered a distillation attack leaking API keys for 1.4% of users, leading to unauthorized AI service charges; providers blocked keys and refunds are being processed.

top.title: TorchNeuron: running HF models on AWS Trainium is easier than ever
top.summary: Hugging Face announced TorchNeuron, a native PyTorch backend for AWS Trainium, entering public beta; it enables eager execution, torch.compile, and supports 89% of top text‑generation models without Optimum Neuron.

top.title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45B compute deal
top.summary: Anthropic and infrastructure provider Nscale are reportedly negotiating a second $45 billion compute agreement, underscoring massive capital flow into AI compute amid both firms’ pending IPOs.

top.title: Making the internet better for AI agents might make it worse for everyone else
top.summary: The surge of personal AI agents (e.g., OpenAI Dots, Meta Muse) is prompting websites to block them, raising concerns that agent traffic could degrade user experience and advertising metrics.

top.title: “We were looking at it wrong”: The explosive claim that’s upended the AI world
top.summary: Goodfire researcher Nick Cammarata claimed LLMs may be far easier to understand than previously thought, sparking debate over interpretability and potential control of neural networks.
